ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture is a food web, labeled with man, birds, duck, chicken, worm, beetle, corn, pechay, guava, bacteria/fungi, etc. corn, pechay, guava are plant-type nodes; worm is located in the middle of the picture and has arrows connected between chicken, birds, and plant nodes. Reasoning: The question asks which one is secondary consumer. A secondary consumer is an organism that is after primary consumers and feeds on other consumers. Judging the trophic levels of each species according to the arrow relationships in the food web in the picture, worm is placed in the secondary consumer position in the consumer relationship. Therefore the answer is worm.
